subject: Re: SIG telemetry & SOC2 logging — evidence and sample logs
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@heimdalltech.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire — telemetry & SOC2 logging (Heimdall RFP)

Camila,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of Heimdall's RFP review we're ingesting SIG and SOC 2 evidence for a small number of vendors. Two asks up front related to telemetry and logging controls (we've pulled these from the SIG questionnaire and our SOC2 sample requests):

1) Control mapping: a completed control-mapping spreadsheet showing how Redwood maps SIG/SOC2 control ids to product and operational controls (we usually look for the mapping column + artifact pointer).

2) Sample artifacts: system event logs, access logs (auth service), and detection alerts for the period 2027-08-01 to 2027-08-31. Ideally a tarball with: system_events.jsonl, auth_access.csv (redacted PII), and one example incident alert + runbook PDF.

Additional asks: retention policy excerpt (where logs are stored, retention duration), and a short note on log integrity (signing or WORM / immutability) for the sample artifacts. We aim to present to our security committee on 2027-09-20, so if we can receive artifacts by 2027-09-16 that would be helpful.

If you prefer, we can take a 25–30 minute call next week to walk the artifacts rather than back-and-forth email.

Regards,
Elaine Park
Director, Vendor Assurance
Heimdall Technologies

[attachment: heimdall-sig-excerpt-telemetry.pdf (85 KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@heimdalltech.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — telemetry & SOC2 logging (Heimdall RFP)

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the control mapping and artifacts for the August window. Quick clarifying points before we start packaging:

- Do you need raw timestamps down to the millisecond or is second-resolution OK?
- For auth_access.csv, we'll redact any customer identifiers and provide a redaction summary.
- We typically provide a short integrity statement and SHA256 checksums for the tarball; will that work for your intake?

We can target delivery by EOD 2027-09-13 to give you a 3-day review before your 9/16 intake deadline. I'll bring in internal owners and confirm the artifact list in a separate note.

If you'd like the walk-through, I can propose a few 30-minute slots for 9/12—9/14.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire — telemetry & SOC2 logging (Heimdall RFP)

Team — forwarding Heimdall's asks (see attached excerpt). They want: control mapping (SIG/SOC2 ids -> internal control), sample artifacts for 2027-08-01 to 2027-08-31, retention statement, and a note on log integrity. Deadline for their intake: 2027-09-16; our proposed delivery: 2027-09-13.

Please confirm owners and outputs below by EOD: 
- Karthik: produce redacted telemetry bundle (system_events.jsonl, auth_access.csv, detection_alert_example.json + runbook.pdf). Tarball name: redwood_soc2-log-sample-2027-08.tar.gz. Redaction rules: remove account IDs, replace user emails with hashed ids; produce redaction summary.
- Kimberly: update control-mapping spreadsheet and include artifact pointers (drive links + control owners). Filename: control-mapping-heimdall.xlsx. Also add short retention policy excerpt (one page).
- Jasmine: can you help validate that the runbook PDF aligns with our incident response evidence templates and produce the rfi-answers-appendix.pdf with short Q/A?

We need to review artifacts internally before sending to client. Can you target 2027-09-12 for an internal drop so I can QA and send on 9/13?

Thanks — Camila

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire — telemetry & SOC2 logging (Heimdall RFP)

Camila — confirmed, I will own the telemetry bundle. Plan and notes: 

- Window: 2027-08-01 to 2027-08-31 (UTC).
- Artifacts to produce: system_events.jsonl (sorted by timestamp), auth_access.csv (redacted), detection_alert_example.json (one confirmed alert with timeline), and runbook.pdf (incident response steps).
- Redaction: replace identifiable account IDs and usernames with hashed tokens; remove any free-text customer PII. I will produce a redaction_summary.txt with a mapping of what was redacted and the rules used.
- Integrity: we'll produce SHA256 checksums for each file and sign the checksum file with our internal artifact-signing key (note: redwood uses an internal signing key; I will include a short statement and link to our signing public key).
- Storage/linking: I'll upload the tarball to our secure evidence folder and share a Google Drive link (permission: view only) for Heimdall. Link will be added to the control-mapping spreadsheet.

Timeline: I'll pull logs from observability this afternoon and aim to have a first drop (internal review) by 2027-09-12 17:00 PT. If anything blocks (redaction tool runs long), I'll flag earlier.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Hi Elaine — thanks for the patience. Attached is our initial evidence package and the control mapping you requested. Summary below: 

Attachments included: 
- redwood_soc2-log-sample-2027-08.tar.gz (system_events.jsonl, auth_access.csv (redacted), detection_alert_example.json, redaction_summary.txt)
- control-mapping-heimdall.xlsx (SIG/SOC2 id -> Redwood control, artifact pointers)
- rfi-answers-appendix.pdf (short answers to the telemetry excerpt you sent)

Highlights / notes: 
- Time resolution: timestamps are second-resolution as requested; millisecond precision is available on request.
- Redaction: all account identifiers replaced with stable hashed tokens; redaction_summary.txt documents every replacement and the rules used.
- Integrity: SHA256 checksums provided for each artifact; checksum file signed by our artifact signing key (public key pointer included in the spreadsheet).
- Retention: retention excerpt included (logs retained in secure object storage for 365 days, operational metrics for 90 days; long-term cold storage for 3 years for specific audit artifacts).

Next steps: if you'd like a short walkthrough, I'm available for a 30-minute call on 2027-09-12 at 10:00 PT or 2027-09-13 at 09:00 PT. Please let me know which works and I'll send a calendar invite.

If you have any immediate questions on the artifacts, loop Karthik (security) or Kimberly (controls) and we'll respond quickly.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
